PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_glute_bridge 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          static_stretching 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chest_press_machine 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          assisted_pullup 2x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_deadlift 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          static_stretching 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Cardio & Core":
        warmup:
          recumbent_bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          treadmill_incline_walk 1x20m rpe 6 rest 0 seconds

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    target_calories: 1500..1700 kcal/day
    deficit: 300..500 kcal/day from maintenance
  MACROS:
    protein: 1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight
    carbs: 40..45% total kcal, focus on low_glycaemic_index
    fats: 25..30% total kcal, prioritize unsaturated_fats
    fiber: 25..35 g/day
  MEAL_STRUCTURE:
    meals_per_day: 3..4
    snacks_per_day: 1..2 (optional, low_glycaemic)
    carbohydrate_distribution: even_across_meals
    pre_workout: small_snack_if_needed (low_glycaemic, 15..20g carbs)
    post_workout: protein_20g_plus_low_glycaemic_carb
  FOOD_GUIDELINES:
    emphasize: vegetables, legumes, whole_grains, lean_protein, nuts, seeds, olive_oil
    limit: added_sugars, refined_grains, saturated_fats, fried_foods
    hydration: 2..2.5 L water/day
    alcohol: limit_to_2_units_per_week
    sodium: <2300 mg/day
    avoid: sugar_sweetened_beverages
    monitor: blood_glucose_pre_and_post_exercise
  SPECIAL_CONSIDERATIONS:
    hypoglycaemia_risk: low_with_metformin_but_monitor
    carry_fast_acting_carb: e.g._glucose_tablets
    adjust_intake: if_blood_glucose_<5.5mmol/L_pre_exercise
    consult_physician: before_major_diet_or_medication_changes
